e1t4g47z15yta.speaker: nekmax
e1t4g47z15yta.text: In old Cambodia, boys often lived at temples and learned reading, writing and the teachings from the monks.

e1k748k91v166.speaker: borey
e1k748k91v166.text: Today Krom Ngoy is coming! The best singer in the whole country!
e1k748k91v166.heard: Today Krom Ngoy is coming! The best singer in the whole country!
e1k748k91v166.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e143minzpcft2.speaker: borey
e143minzpcft2.text: I heard him once at a village festival. When you listen to his songs, you laugh, then you cry — you're busy the whole time!
e143minzpcft2.heard: I heard him once at a village festival. When you listen to his songs, you laugh, then you cry — you're busy the whole time!

e1rm1tfbkvfpl.heard: That's a khse diev — an instrument with just one string. They say Krom Ngoy would put it together on the spot, from the walking stick

e9y2edx3eyel.speaker: narr
e9y2edx3eyel.text: He held the gourd against his chest and plucked the string. Bonn, bonn… a low sound drifted out over the river.

e14a15z35um5w.speaker: kromngoy
e14a15z35um5w.text: ♪ The rice field will not wait for you — a morning slept away won't come back
e14a15z35um5w.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1wwtse9tjspe.speaker: kromngoy
e1wwtse9tjspe.text: ♪ Learn your letters and you'll see the road — never learn, and you'll be fooled

e1xbcbrw8j8b2.speaker: narr
e1xbcbrw8j8b2.text: The crowd burst out laughing and nodded. Borey was clapping and humming along.

e7vxpi6b1xjm.speaker: nekmax
e7vxpi6b1xjm.text: Krom Ngoy taught through his songs — about work in the fields, and why learning matters. The song you just heard is a simple retelling of what he taught.
e7vxpi6b1xjm.heard: Krom Ngoy taught through his songs—about work in the fields, and why learning matters. The song you just heard is a simple retelling of what he taught.

ebqw85jj6sd1.speaker: narr
ebqw85jj6sd1.text: When the song ended, the old man looked your way and grinned.
ebqw85jj6sd1.heard: When the song ended, the old man looked your way and grinned.
ebqw85jj6sd1.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

eithuey1a9dd.speaker: kromngoy
eithuey1a9dd.text: Haven't seen your face before. Come from far away, have you?

e13s1ggu2ikqy.speaker: kromngoy
e13s1ggu2ikqy.text: I'm Krom Ngoy. The name I was born with is Ouk Ou, but everyone calls me Krom Ngoy.
e13s1ggu2ikqy.heard: I'm Krom Ngoy. The name I was born with is Ouk Ou, but everyone calls me Krom Ngoy.

e42kho17cb9q.speaker: kromngoy
e42kho17cb9q.text: Well, well, you came again. My songs must have caught your fancy.
e42kho17cb9q.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1ejhrfzaozuf.speaker: kromngoy
e1ejhrfzaozuf.text: Haven't seen your face before. …No, wait — have we met somewhere?

e900bqgci2gp.text: I'm Borey! Krom Ngoy, how do you remember all your songs? Are they written on paper?
e900bqgci2gp.heard: Krom Ngoy, how do you remember all your songs? Are they written on paper?
e900bqgci2gp.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

evvxk1ta3a61.speaker: kromngoy
evvxk1ta3a61.text: Ha ha ha. I've never once written a song on paper. They're all kept in here.
evvxk1ta3a61.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ed2erra11m56.speaker: narr
ed2erra11m56.text: The old man thumped his chest with his big hand.

e1n1yegh1tsg6.text: But you know, I'm sixty-five now. And as a song passes from mouth to mouth, little by little, it changes.
e1n1yegh1tsg6.heard: But you know, I'm sixty-five now. And as a song passes from mouth to mouth, little by little, it changes.

ewo1xnr1tivw.speaker: kromngoy
ewo1xnr1tivw.text: That's why I'm going to the temple today. To have my songs made into a proper book.
ewo1xnr1tivw.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eswchpk186fb.speaker: kromngoy
eswchpk186fb.text: That's right. I'll sing slowly, and the young monks will write them down, word by word, so they tell me.
eswchpk186fb.heard: That's right. I'll sing slowly, and the young monks will write them down, word by word, so they tell me.
eswchpk186fb.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ew7u41gt1fmi.speaker: kromngoy
ew7u41gt1fmi.text: Just so. But write them down, and children a hundred years from now can read them just as I sang them.
ew7u41gt1fmi.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ezrp8ockdjja.text: Slowly, eh? Sing slowly and folks fall asleep, you know. Ha ha ha.
